verdict.rationale: Token2 is a FIDO2/PIV/TOTP security-key management toolset; the only automation-like behavior evidenced is a fixed system tray watcher that opens its GUI when a key is inserted (token2-gh-7), which is a hardcoded behavior, not a user-configurable rule engine for defining custom triggers and actions across events. No evidence of a rules/automation engine, webhooks, or user-defined event-action bindings.
